zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the {model} **{name}** ({host})? A pairing code will be shown on the display.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Enter the 6-digit code that is now shown on the display.

data_description.code: The 6-digit code shown on the display. A new code is shown when it expires.

legacy_confirm.title: Older ShellyElevate version
legacy_confirm.description: **{name}** ({host}) runs an older ShellyElevate version without the native Home Assistant API. It can be added with basic features (relays, sensors, settings, media playback without status), but its HTTP API has no authentication. Update the app later to get push updates, the voice assistant and the Bluetooth proxy.

profile.title: Apply a settings profile
profile.description: Apply one of your settings profiles to the new display. The default profile is pre-selected.

data_description.profile: Settings profile written to the new display. Choose — to keep its current settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again with {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The display no longer accepts the stored token, or it presents a different security certificate (for example after the app was reinstalled). Pair again to continue. A pairing code will be shown on the display.

data_description.host: New IP address or hostname of the display.

upgrade_confirm.title: Switch {name} to the new API
upgrade_confirm.description: **{name}** ({host}) now runs a ShellyElevate version with the native Home Assistant API. Pair it to get authentication, push updates, the voice assistant and the Bluetooth proxy. A pairing code will be shown on the display.

display.title: Add a Shelly Wall Display
display.description: Enter the address of a Shelly Wall Display running ShellyElevate. To install ShellyElevate on a new display, open **Shelly Elevate** in the sidebar and go to **Install**.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the display.
data_description.port: Port of the ShellyElevate API (default 8443). Older app versions are found on port 8080 automatically.

user.title: Shelly Elevate
user.description: Add a Shelly Wall Display that already runs ShellyElevate, or only add the Shelly Elevate panel to the sidebar. From the panel you can install ShellyElevate on a new display.

menu_options.panel: Only add the panel (install ShellyElevate on a new display)

wall_display_confirm.title: Shelly Wall Display found
wall_display_confirm.description: A Shelly Wall Display was found at {host}. Set it up with Shelly Elevate? If ShellyElevate already runs on it, it is added. Otherwise the Shelly Elevate panel is added to the sidebar, where you can install ShellyElevate on it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the display.
error.invalid_code: Invalid pairing code. Check the code shown on the display.
error.pairing_expired: The code expired. A new code is now shown on the display.
error.rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.profile_failed: The profile could not be applied.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the display.
abort.rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
abort.not_shellyelevateintegration: This is not a ShellyElevate display.
abort.incompatible_api: This ShellyElevate version uses an incompatible API version. Update the integration or the app.
abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different display.
abort.not_upgraded: The display still runs an older ShellyElevate version without pairing.
abort.upgrade_successful: The display now uses the new API.
abort.certificate_mismatch: The display presents a different security certificate than the one Home Assistant paired with. Pair it again.
abort.panel_entry: The panel has nothing to reconfigure.

data.watchdog: Restart the app automatically when it stops responding
data.ha_login: Log the dashboard into Home Assistant

data_description.auto_backup: Takes a snapshot of the display settings after every change.
data_description.adb: Lets Home Assistant install and update the app, take screenshots and rescue the display over ADB. ADB over Wi-Fi must stay enabled on the display.
data_description.thermostat: Creates a thermostat entity that switches a relay of the display based on the temperature.
data_description.backup_keep: Older automatic backups are removed first; named backups are kept longest.
data_description.relays_as_lights: Creates the relays as light entities instead of switches.
data_description.update_channel: Beta also offers pre-releases of the ShellyElevate app.
data_description.ha_login: The display gets its own login and never shows the login page. Turning this off logs the dashboard out.
data_description.ha_login_user: Empty uses the default of the Shelly Elevate panel: the non-admin, local-only user “Shelly Elevate” unless another user was picked there.

thermostat.title: Thermostat
thermostat.description: The control loop runs in Home Assistant. Without a selection the display's own temperature sensor is used.

data_description.thermostat_relay: Relay that switches the heater or cooler.
data_description.thermostat_sensor: Leave empty to use the display's own sensor.
data_description.thermostat_tolerance: The relay switches at target temperature ± tolerance.
data_description.thermostat_min_cycle: Minimum time between two switching operations (0 = off).
data_description.thermostat_mode: Heat switches the relay on below the target temperature, cool switches it on above it.
data_description.thermostat_min_temp: Lowest target temperature that can be set.
data_description.thermostat_max_temp: Highest target temperature that can be set.

error.invalid_temp_range: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum.
error.no_relays: This display has no relay to switch, so it cannot be a thermostat.
error.sensor_required: This display has no temperature sensor. Choose a temperature sensor.

legacy_app.title: {name} runs an older ShellyElevate version
legacy_app.description: Push updates, buttons and gestures, the voice assistant, the Bluetooth proxy and media status require a ShellyElevate version with the native API. Update the app on the display (for example with the update entity).

duplicate_devices.title: {name} also appears as a second device

confirm.title: Turn off duplicate integrations on {name}
confirm.description: MQTT discovery, the ESPHome-compatible Bluetooth proxy, or both are enabled on the display. They create a second Home Assistant device for the same display. This integration already provides everything, so they will be turned off; the Bluetooth proxy then runs through this integration. You can then delete the old MQTT/ESPHome device.

abort.cannot_connect: The change could not be sent to the display.

confirm.title: Turn off the legacy HTTP API on {name}
confirm.description: The legacy HTTP API lets anyone on your network control the display without a password. It is not needed by this integration.

abort.cannot_connect: The change could not be sent to the display.

confirm.title: Rescue {name}
confirm.description: The app does not respond, but the display is reachable over ADB. Restart the app, or reinstall it.

abort.not_loaded: The display is not set up.
abort.no_adb: ADB is not enabled for this display.
abort.cannot_connect: The change could not be sent to the display.

permissions.title: Grant permissions on {name}
permissions.description: Missing: {problems}. Home Assistant grants the missing permissions over ADB (microphone, location and Bluetooth as needed, the permission the ADB over Wi‑Fi switch of the app needs, and location turned on for Bluetooth scans) and restarts the app if anything changed.

enable_adb.title: Enable ADB on {name}
enable_adb.description:
Missing: {problems}. These permissions can only be granted over ADB, which is not enabled for this display.

1. On the display, turn on **ADB over Wi‑Fi** in the ShellyElevate settings, or enable **ADB debugging** and **ADB over Wi‑Fi** (port 5555) in the Android developer options. On newer Shelly firmware, also turn on **ADB - WiFi** in the Shelly developer settings.
2. Submit to connect to {host}:5555. If the display asks whether to allow debugging, allow it and choose to always allow this computer.

Home Assistant then grants the permissions and turns on **Use ADB** in the integration options.

abort.cannot_connect: The permissions could not be granted: {error}
abort.adb_unreachable: Home Assistant could not open an ADB session to {host}:5555. Enable ADB over Wi‑Fi on the display as described and try again.
abort.still_missing: Android did not grant: {missing}. Grant it on the display under Android settings → Apps → ShellyElevate → Permissions.

invalid_import.message: The imported data does not contain settings.

adb_connect_failed.message: Could not open an ADB session to {host}: {error}. ADB debugging and ADB over Wi-Fi must be enabled in the Android developer options (on newer Shelly firmware also ADB - WiFi in the Shelly developer settings).

apk_checksum.message: The downloaded app does not match its checksum.

no_release.message: No ShellyElevate release with an APK was found.

no_install_method.message: This display can only be updated with ADB enabled.

app_update_timeout.message: The display did not finish the app update within 10 minutes.

app_update_failed.message: The app could not update itself: {reason}

permissions_still_missing.message: Still missing after granting over ADB: {missing}

announce_timeout.message: The announcement did not finish in time.

config_entry_failed.message: The display could not be added to Home Assistant: {reason}

ha_login_user_invalid.message: User {user} cannot be used for the dashboard login: it does not exist, is inactive or is a system user.

backup_settings.name: Back up settings
backup_settings.description: Takes a snapshot of the settings of one or more displays.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional name; named backups are kept longest.

restore_settings.name: Restore settings
restore_settings.description: Restores a settings backup (only changed settings are written).

backup_id.name: Backup ID
backup_id.description: Backup to restore; the latest if empty.

apply_profile.name: Apply profile
apply_profile.description: Applies a settings profile to displays.

save_profile.name: Save profile
save_profile.description: Saves the settings of a display as a profile (per-display settings are left out).

device_id.name: Display
device_id.description: Display to take the settings from.

name.name: Name
name.description: Profile name (an existing profile with this name is replaced).

make_default.name: Default for new displays
make_default.description: Use this profile for newly added displays.

copy_settings.name: Copy settings
copy_settings.description: Copies settings from one display to others.

export_settings.name: Export settings
export_settings.description: Returns the settings of a display as JSON.

import_settings.name: Import settings
import_settings.description: Imports exported settings as a backup and optionally applies them.

get_settings.name: Get settings
get_settings.description: Returns all settings of a display (secrets redacted).

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Settings to write as key/value pairs, for example screenSaverDelay: 60.

navigate.name: Navigate
navigate.description: Shows a dashboard path or URL on the display (not persisted).

path.name: Path
path.description: Path relative to the dashboard URL, e.g. /lovelace/cameras.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Shows a message on the screen.

adb_shell.name: ADB shell command
adb_shell.description: Runs a shell command on the display over ADB (admin only).

install_app.name: Install app
install_app.description: Installs (or reinstalls) the ShellyElevate app over ADB.

revert_display.name: Revert display to stock
revert_display.description: Removes ShellyElevate and everything its installation changed over ADB, and gives the display back to the stock Shelly app.

remove_from_home_assistant.name: Remove from Home Assistant
remove_from_home_assistant.description: Remove the display from Home Assistant once the app is gone.

reboot.name: Restart the display
reboot.description: Restart the display at the end.

disable_adb.name: Turn off ADB
disable_adb.description: Also turn off ADB over Wi-Fi at the very end. Home Assistant can then no longer reach the display over ADB, and the display is not restarted.

accept_wifi_loss.name: Accept losing Wi-Fi
accept_wifi_loss.description: Revert even if the display's Wi-Fi network was set up in ShellyElevate: uninstalling it removes that network.
